lead: The one-page summary — profile, savings, verdict — is always included. Add any of these sections:
timelineNote: Portfolio balance by age with the retirement-age marker.
monteCarloNote: Percentile bands (10th–90th) and success rate from a fresh 500-run simulation. Takes a moment to compute.
milestonesNote: Retirement, CPP/OAS start, RRIF conversion, spending-phase changes and one-time cash events, in age order.
tableNote: Every year with balances, withdrawals, tax and benefits — plus the per-year drill-down (withdrawal sources, growth per account, reverse mortgage, events). Prints several pages.
waitingMc: Waiting for the Monte Carlo simulation…
simWhenNeeded: The simulation runs when the chart is needed.
running500: Running 500 simulations for the fan chart…

sheet.title: RE: tired — Retirement Plan Summary
sheet.timelineTitle: Projection timeline — household portfolio by age

sheet.emptyTimeline: Nothing to draw — the plan has no savings yet. Add balances on the Plans page and the timeline will render.
sheet.emptyMc: Nothing to draw — the plan has no savings yet. Add balances on the Plans page and the simulation will render.
sheet.retirementDetail: contributions stop; withdrawals begin toward {{amount}}/yr spending (today's $)
sheet.rrifDetail: RRSP converts to RRIF; mandatory minimum withdrawals begin
sheet.rdspTitle: Registered Disability Savings Plan. Growth is tax-sheltered; on withdrawal the grant/bond/growth portion is taxable (only contribution principal is tax-free).
sheet.fhsaTitle: First Home Savings Account. Contributions are deductible; growth is tax-sheltered. Transfers to the RRSP at retirement.
sheet.rdspCell: Contribution basis {{amount}} (tax-free); the rest is taxable on withdrawal
sheet.fhsaCell: Contributed to date {{amount}}; transfers to the RRSP at retirement
sheet.spouseNote: Nominal (future) dollars of each year. Spouse years are their own ages.
sheet.spouseNoteOffset: Nominal (future) dollars of each year. Spouse years are their own ages (spouse is {{n}} {{unit}} {{rel}}).
sheet.footer: CPP from age {{cpp}} · OAS from {{oas}} · inflation-adjusted spending · Canadian federal + {{province}} provincial tax. Estimates only — not financial advice.
